text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Why?! I was so convinced I
could win.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
My legs just like... wouldn't listen to me.
Don't tell
me I've hit my limit already.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Next time... huh. You're right, this loss
isn't the
end.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
There's a lot we'll have to review, like
how I
approach turns, or my initial
momentum...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's just like modeling. You get better
step by
step, then eventually you start
getting bigger
projects.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think I really believed that?
Like hell
I've hit my limit!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I mean, like, in modeling, I get gigs that
seem out
of my league all the time, but I
make it work.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wait, so why am I yelling at you then? I
don't
know... Sorry about that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
All right, no more moping. I need to
accept the
results and move on!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I should take action before I start
complaining.
Just watch, Trainer—the
next race is mine!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
